q: The historical migration of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and Muslims from Makkah to Madinah is the ____. (P5)
explain: The Hijrah in 622 CE marks the beginning of the Islamic Hijri calendar.

q: The first beloved wife of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) who comforted and supported him was Lady ____. (P5)
explain: Lady Khadijah was a successful merchant and the first person to embrace Islam.

q: Sayings, actions, and approvals of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) recorded by companions are called ____. (P5)

q: The companion known as 'As-Siddiq' (The Truthful) who became the first Caliph of Islam was ____. (P5)

q: Prophetic history (P5): Who was Prophet Nuh (AS) in Islamic heritage?
